name: tersign
description: Tersign plugin — the record layer for the machine age. Verify a counterparty's receipt files offline and its evidence bundles with a published checker fetched from tersign.ai, with no account, and put your own agent's actions on a neutral, independently verifiable record.

plugins.name: tersign
plugins.description: The record layer for the machine age: counter-signed records of what AI agents do and pay. Verify a counterparty's x402 receipt file offline, or check an evidence bundle with the action records in it using a published checker fetched from tersign.ai, with no account and no API key; record disclosures into a neutral hash-chained ledger anchored to Bitcoin with no configuration (the first call self-provisions a signer-keyed account with a key generated on your machine); issue counter-signed receipts from a seller account you configure in the plugin's settings; fetch a venue-formatted envelope for the venue that will hear it.
